title: CEMENTS & SEALERS
summary: Applied-material code table, part 2: plastic seam cement 3851624 (57a–57f), deadener 9981300 (58a), price-label adhesive 3764800 (59a), selector-plate adhesive 3849167 (62a), vinyl-roof cement 3903598 (68a, option C08), strip sealer 3912973 (69a–69b, soft top), windshield seal 3926350 (70a), glass-to-seal cement 3940692 (71a–71b), reclaimed-rubber sealer 9980621 (73a–73g, dash pass-throughs and windshield wiper mounts) and glass primer 9981282 (76a).
notes_internal: Chart sheet (no drawing, no callouts): applied-material codes. PART cell = GM part number + description from the left column, repeated on every row of its group (on the page it is printed once per group).
Words hyphenated across line breaks in USAGE are joined (e.g. RE-/TAINER -> RETAINER); multi-line cells joined with a space.
Model box reads 19000 (all models), so models = [].
Rows with two UPC/SUB-GRP lines (70a, 76a) are written '1 / C07' and 'F / A': UPC 1 subgroup F, and option C07 subgroup A.
70a UPC '1' is half under the binder hole but legible.
76a alternate part: first digit smudged (looks like S/9; OCR read '$'); written '?985052'. Page 28 prints the same alternate primer clearly as 9985052.
3851624 here is a cement; the same number is a sealing strip on F18 (p112). Copied as printed.
Rev 1 date: second digit of the day smeared ('12-1?-69'). Circled 1 beside 57f.
Codes jump 59a -> 62a -> 68a -> 69a -> 70a -> 71a -> 73a -> 76a; gaps are not marked as removed on this sheet.
